sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Eye on Display is a news website and industry directory covering large-format printing, signage, printed packaging and graphic reproduction.

Industry: Media & Publishing · Size: not published

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Eye on Display scores 29 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 85% confidence. The score is carried by industry fit (12/30) and event engagement (12/15). Nothing was found for application fit and company size, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Drytac (40% similar on print, display, media, graphics); Mactac (24% similar on print, signage, media, printing); Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (7% similar on graphics, wrap, year, graphic). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Application fit: 4 more application area(s) would reach the ceiling.
• Company size: Any published revenue or headcount would unlock up to 15 points.
• Flags on the record: size unknown
